definition: נָתִיב noun masculine Job 28:7 path, pathway (as raised ); — absolute ׳ נ Job 18:10 + 3 t.; construct נְתִיב Ps 119:35 suffix 3 feminine singular נְתִיבָהֿ Prov 12:28 (si vera lectio, see below; on omission of Mappik see Ges «GKC:91e»§ 91e , see below); — path Job 18:10 (figurative) Job 28:7 ; Job 41:24 (track); Ps 78:50 (figurative); נְתִיב מִצְוֺתֶיךָ Ps 119:35 the path of thy commands ; דֶּרֶךְ נְתִיבָה אַלמָֿוֶת Prov 12:28 the journey of her pathway is no-death! || בְּאֹרַח צְדָקָה חַיִּים Ew Be De . see אַל a above; others read אֶלֿ , and either translate ׳ נ by-paths ( Hi Str ), or substitute a synonym of 'wickedness' (compare Now Frankenb ; Perles Analekten 87 f. נִתְעָבִים after Levy ChWB i. 28 b ).
